Conversely, if patients diagnosed with Caffey disease lack variants in COL1A1 or COL1A2, or if arthrochalasia EDS is linked to an entirely different genetic pathway, this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: The presence of common variants in COL1A1 or COL1A2 with frequencies >1% in gnomAD would cast doubt on their role as causative genes for rare diseases, necessitating investigation into specific rare variants.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis in collagen synthesis provides a potential avenue for therapeutic strategies targeting extracellular matrix integrity, which could benefit patients with both conditions. For example, therapies aimed at improving collagen stability or production could be explored.
